chunks: And Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī narrated from him that he said:
"It will be counted for you when you join them, even if you do not follow them; it will be counted for you just as it is counted for you when you are with one whom you follow."

key_terms.تَقْتَدِي: you follow in prayer behind an imam
key_terms.تَقْتَدِي بِهِ: you take as the one you follow in prayer
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them, meaning alongside the group
key_terms.مِثْلُ: the like of or equivalent to
key_terms.يُحْسَبُ: is counted or reckoned as reward

ai.seo_question: Is reward counted for joining a congregational prayer even if one does not do iqtida' behind the imam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that joining others in congregational prayer brings reward for the believer, even when he does not actually follow that imam in iqtida'. It highlights the value of participating with the congregation and indicates that such participation is counted with reward similar to praying behind one whom one properly follows.
